payload.title: Restore complete newest-version activity evidence in optimization ranking
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want portfolio ranking to retrieve the newest version activity for every versioned score, so that the cooldown policy can distinguish recent work from eligible work without incomplete coverage.

Observed platform defect: the exhaustive score inventory can return a champion version identifier while its reverse versions relationship is empty, causing otherwise eligible scores to fail activity coverage. The fix must remain exhaustive, include unpromoted versions, preserve opaque identifiers, and avoid per-score N+1 reads.

Feature: Complete score activity evidence

Scenario: A score has version history not visible through the reverse relationship
Given an exhaustive score inventory row has a champion version identifier and score update timestamp
And the reverse score versions relationship is empty
When optimization ranking collects newest-version activity
Then it retrieves the newest version through a complete account-scoped version inventory
And evaluates the fixed cooldown against the later activity timestamp
And preserves exact coverage when all evidence is complete

Scenario: Version evidence remains incomplete
Given neither inventory path can establish a newest version for a versioned score
When optimization ranking runs
Then the score fails closed
And the portfolio is not exact
And the primary next action reports evidence repair rather than rank completion

Out of scope: client-specific data repair, score mutation, optimizer launch, and cooldown-policy changes.
